```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
```


```{python}
lex = pd.read_csv('data/lex.csv') 
```

```{python}
mortality = pd.read_csv("data/child_mortality_0_5_year_olds_dying_per_1000_born.csv")
```


```{python}

# Clean column names
lex = lex.rename(columns={"country": "Country"})
mortality = mortality.rename(columns={"country": "Country"})

# Convert from wide to long format
lex_long = lex.melt(id_vars="Country", var_name="Year", value_name="Life Expectancy")
mortality_long = mortality.melt(id_vars="Country", var_name="Year", value_name="Child Mortality")

# Convert year to numeric
lex_long["Year"] = pd.to_numeric(lex_long["Year"])
mortality_long["Year"] = pd.to_numeric(mortality_long["Year"])

# Merge datasets
merged = pd.merge(lex_long, mortality_long, on=["Country", "Year"])
```

# Life Expectancy Analysis

## Life Expectancy Overview
```{python}
latest_year = lex_long['Year'].max()
latest_lex = lex_long[lex_long['Year'] == latest_year]
```

```{python}
top_country = latest_lex.loc[latest_lex['Life Expectancy'].idxmax()]
low_country = latest_lex.loc[latest_lex['Life Expectancy'].idxmin()]
mean_lex = latest_lex['Life Expectancy'].mean()
```


::: {.valuebox title="Highest Life Expectancy" color="#4CAF50" icon="arrow-up"}
{top_country['Country']}: {top_country['Life Expectancy']:.1f} years
:::

::: {.valuebox title="Lowest Life Expectancy" color="#F44336" icon="arrow-down"}
{low_country['Country']}: {low_country['Life Expectancy']:.1f} years
:::

::: {.valuebox title="Global Average" color="#2196F3" icon="globe"}
{mean_lex:.1f} years
:::



## Life Expectancy by Country (Map)
```{python}
fig = px.choropleth(latest_lex, locations="Country", locationmode="country names",
                    color="Life Expectancy",
                    color_continuous_scale="Viridis",
                    title="Life Expectancy by Country in Latest Year",
                    labels={"Life Expectancy": "Years"})
fig.show()
```

## Life Expectancy Trends (Top 5 Countries)
```{python}
top_countries = latest_lex.sort_values("Life Expectancy", ascending=False).head(5)["Country"]
fig = px.line(lex_long[lex_long["Country"].isin(top_countries)],
              x="Year", y="Life Expectancy", color="Country",
              title="Trends in Life Expectancy (Top 5 Countries)",
              labels={"Life Expectancy": "Years"})
fig.show()
```

## Life Expectancy Table
```{python}
table_data = lex_long[lex_long["Country"].isin(top_countries)].pivot(index="Year", columns="Country", values="Life Expectancy")
table_data.tail()
```

# Child Mortality Analysis

## Child Mortality Overview
```{python}
latest_mortality = mortality_long[mortality_long['Year'] == latest_year]
high = latest_mortality.loc[latest_mortality['Child Mortality'].idxmax()]
low = latest_mortality.loc[latest_mortality['Child Mortality'].idxmin()]
mean_cm = latest_mortality['Child Mortality'].mean()
```


::: {.valuebox title="Highest Mortality" color="#E53935" icon="arrow-up"}
{high['Country']}: {high['Child Mortality']:.1f} deaths/1000
:::

::: {.valuebox title="Lowest Mortality" color="#43A047" icon="arrow-down"}
{low['Country']}: {low['Child Mortality']:.1f} deaths/1000
:::

::: {.valuebox title="Global Average" color="#1E88E5" icon="globe"}
{mean_cm:.1f} deaths/1000
:::



## Child Mortality by Country (Map)
```{python}
fig = px.choropleth(latest_mortality, locations="Country", locationmode="country names",
                    color="Child Mortality",
                    color_continuous_scale="Reds",
                    title="Child Mortality Rate by Country in Latest Year",
                    labels={"Child Mortality": "Deaths per 1000"})
fig.show()
```

## Child Mortality Over Time (Top 5 Countries)
```{python}
top_countries_cm = latest_mortality.sort_values("Child Mortality", ascending=False).head(5)["Country"]
fig = px.line(mortality_long[mortality_long["Country"].isin(top_countries_cm)],
              x="Year", y="Child Mortality", color="Country",
              title="Trends in Child Mortality (Top 5 Countries)",
              labels={"Child Mortality": "Deaths per 1000"})
fig.show()
```

## Child Mortality Comparison Table
```{python}
table_data_cm = mortality_long[mortality_long["Country"].isin(top_countries_cm)].pivot(index="Year", columns="Country", values="Child Mortality")
table_data_cm.tail()
```

# Relationship Between Indicators

## Scatter Plot: Life Expectancy vs. Child Mortality
```{python}
latest_data = merged[merged["Year"] == latest_year]
fig = px.scatter(latest_data, x="Child Mortality", y="Life Expectancy", color="Country",
                 hover_name="Country",
                 title="Life Expectancy vs. Child Mortality (Latest Year)",
                 labels={"Child Mortality": "Deaths per 1000", "Life Expectancy": "Years"})
fig.show()
```

## Highlight High-Risk Countries
```{python}
high_risk = latest_data[(latest_data['Child Mortality'] > mean_cm) & (latest_data['Life Expectancy'] < mean_lex)]
high_risk[['Country', 'Life Expectancy', 'Child Mortality']]
```

## Key Insights

Countries with higher life expectancy tend to have lower child mortality rates, suggesting stronger healthcare and socioeconomic conditions. The scatter plot demonstrates a negative correlation. High-risk countries, identified in the table above, may benefit from targeted interventions.
